residual_findings.title: timeline.event.append does explicit-ID rename AFTER append_event succeeds, outside any transaction; rename failure leaves event under auto-allocated id
residual_findings.note: WL-A. Edge case: rename failure (e.g., ID collision) leaves orphan event under auto-id. Low practical risk (local single-writer). Future: wrap append+rename in single transaction.
